text: City Council, at its meeting on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted Item TE7.17 as amended, and in so doing, has referred Toronto and East York Community Council Recommendations 5, 6 and 7 back to the Toronto and East York Community Council for further consideration.

City Council on October 2 and 3, 2019, adopted the following: 1.
